quests.title: Blocks!
quests.desc: Get a Block. Literally any Block. \n\nEvery Player should know Blocks are the building Blocks of building. To actually build something you will need Blocks.

quests.title: Колоди
quests.desc:
What rolls down stairs 
Alone or in pairs... 
Rolls over your neighbor's dog 
What's great for a snack 
And fits on your back? 
It's Log! Log! Log!

quests.title: Paxel
quests.desc:
Tools are very important in &2&lMinecraft&r but so is inventory space. So why not clear some space up by making a Paxel! 
Paxels are a combination of Pickaxes (P), Axes (axe), and Shovels (els). 

They can strip wood, make paths, and mine any blocks that same pickaxe/axe/shovel tier can!

quests.title: Rechiseled
quests.desc:
A continuation of &lChiseled&r, &4&lRechiseled&r! 

All of this Mod works within the Chisel Tool, Right Click with it to pull up its GUI. 
On the Left is where you choose the design and the Bottom Right is where you put the Blocks. 

Above it you can view the design in set patterns: just the 1 Block, 3x1 Blocks, or 3x3 Wall of that Block. You can also set the image to either spin or not spin by clicking the button! 

Next to where the Blocks go, you can click the Chisel, doing this will set the selected design, to every Block in your Inventory that can be changed. 

Also does not have Durability!

quests.title: Chipped
quests.desc:
&b&lChipped&r is similar to Chisels Mods as it changes the designs of Blocks, but &b&lChipped&r has their own way of doing so! 

&b&lChipped&r instead uses Stations you'll need to go to, to change Blocks. 

There's 7 different Stations each change different Blocks: Carpenters Table changes Wood, Glassblower changes Glass. 

And 6 of those Stations can be changed into a handheld Item for easier access. 

There's even Backpack Upgrades for them!

quests.title: Building Gadgets
quests.desc:
&l&aBuilding Gadgets 2&r is a Mod that adds a few very helpful Items. 

All for of course, building! 

Each requires &cEnergy&r to work and has a Menu which is pulled up by default &lG&r.

quests.title: Macaw's Fences and Walls
quests.desc:
This &b&lMacaw&r Mod adds new types of Fences, Gates, and Walls. 

Yes, the barbed wire will hurt you. 

No, you can't jump over any of them normally.

quests.title: Macaw's Doors
quests.desc:
&b&lMacaw's Doors&r adds all sorts of different Doors and variants of Doors. 
You want the Birch design but with Spruce Wood? You can have it! 

Heck it even has Hospital Doors!

quests.title: Macaw's Furniture
quests.desc: The quintessential &9Macaw&r Mod, &9&lMacaw's Furniture&r! \n\nIt adds everything you need! Chairs, Tables, Bookshelves, and even Drawers!

quests.title: Macaw's Holidays
quests.desc:
Take notes &lCorail&r! This is how you do Holidays! (I say this will 100% love, we love you &lCorail&r!) 

This addition adds plenty of decorations for Christmas and Halloween. 

From Christmas Trees, Presents, and Lights for Christmas to Pumpkins, Spiders, and Witch Hats for Halloween.

quests.title: Macaw's Lights and Lamps
quests.desc:
&bMacaw&r decided the furniture wasn't enough, he needed his Macaw home to have more than just natural lighting from his &b&lMacaw Windows&r. 

So now we have &b&lMacaw's Lights and Lamps&r which adds all sorts of Light Sources. 

From Lamps to Lanterns to Chanderliers!

quests.title: Macaw's Paths and Pavings
quests.desc: &b&lPaths and Pathways&r adds tons of different Carpet like Blocks (and full Blocks and Slab versions). \n\nThese are obviously used as Paths, they just look much nicer than the &2&lMinecraft&r Path Block.

quests.title: Macaw's Roofs
quests.desc: This one adds Non-&2&lMinecraft&r Blocks so I'd rather not discuss it.

quests.title: Macaw's Trapdoors
quests.desc: Similar to &b&lMacaw's Doors&r this one adds different types and versions of Trapdoors. \n\nYou want a Jungle Trapdoor with the Spruce Pattern? Well now you can!

quests.title: Macaw's Windows
quests.desc: Windows, Windows Panes, Winder Shutters, Curtains, Blinds, to even Parapets! \n\nI don't even know what that is!

quests.title: Simply Light
quests.desc:
&lSimply Lights&r adds very simple to make and easy to use lights.

When inverted they will work without Redstone and will turn off when the Redstone signal goes activates it.

There are plenty of different colors and shapes of it!

quests.title: Torchmaster
quests.desc:
Now these are super helpful, you should definitely check them out! 

The actual Light Source is the Feral Flare Lantern. It will place invisible Light Sources around 20 Blocks or more around it. 

The Mega Torch is different: it doesn't emit Light but it does Block all Hostile Mob spawns with 64 Blocks of it! Useful for those using Night Vision. 

The Dread Lamp does the opposite, it blocks Passive Mob spawns in the same area.

quests.title: Ars Nouveau Lights
quests.desc: The magical realm of &d&lArs Nouveau&r brings us Magelights! Light Sources of pure magic! \n\nThey can either be placed normally using Spells or you can craft a Magelight Lantern and place that instead.

quests.title: Chipped Lights
quests.desc: Man some Light Sources are just so butt ugly! \n\nLets change that!

quests.title: Light Sources
quests.desc:
Light is a very important part of any Base. 

It keeps Monsters from Spawning, helps to see, and even adds more Color and life to your Builds! 

Or you can just use Night Vision but where's the fun in that!

quests.title: XyCraft Lights
quests.desc:
&l&9X&cy&aC&8r&aa&cf&9t&r of course with being all around Colors, the Lights are also based on Color. 

The RGB Lights will be whatever Dye they are made with. 

The Dye specifically not the Gem.

quests.title: Regions Unexplored Logs
quests.desc: &l&cRegions Unexplored&r is another Biome Mod, this one new to &l&6AllTheMods!&r \n\nOf course with Biomes comes more Trees!

quests.title: Chipped Logs
quests.desc: The 10 &2Vanilla&r Logs are wonderful, but they only have so many designs! \n\nSo of course &l&bChipped&r, chipped in by adding dozens of new designs for those Logs!

quests.title: Oh The Biomes We've Gone Wood
quests.desc: &l&aOh The Biomes We've Gone&r is a continuation of &l&aOh The Biomes You'll Go&r which is a pun off the Dr. Seuss book "Oh the Places You'll Go".\n\nIt adds tons of gorgeous new biomes! With new plants, rocks, and of course trees!

tasks.name: Oh The Biomes We've Gone Wood

quests.title: Productive Trees
quests.desc:
&lProductive Trees&r is all about Trees and Breeding Trees to make more Trees. 

So you are safe to guess it brings more Wood types to &2&lMinecraft&r! 

Heck even some specialty Wood!

quests.title: Ars Nouveau Logs
quests.desc: &d&lArs Nouveau&r is a very fun magic Mod and with it brings its own set of Wood! \n\nArchwood comes in 5 different colors of trees that spawn in most Biomes but mostly in their Archwood Biome!

quests.title: Скло
quests.desc:
If you're like me and don't like living in a Box (it reminds me too much of School), then you'll like to have Glass in your Builds to see outside. 

While the normal Vanilla ones are nice of course we can do much better! 

We can even get some use out of it!

quests.title: Glassential
quests.desc:
&3&lGlassential&r is very important Mod for building, even for builds with purposes! 
It's not just normal Glass, these have abilities which can be read while hovering over the Item! 

Like Ethereal Glass which you can walk through but Mobs can't. (I used that for my Bee Dome in 9sky!)

quests.title: XyCraft Glass
quests.desc: &l&9X&cy&aC&8r&aa&cf&9t&r adds plenty of Glasses with it's &lWorld Core&r! \n\nFrom ones you can walk through, to glowing ones, to stronger ones!

quests.title: Chipped Glass
quests.desc: From normal Glass, to Glass with Panes, to even Mosaics!

quests.title: Chisel Reborn
quests.desc:
&l&cChisel Reborn&r is another Mod based off of &lChiseled&r. 

The essence of the Mod is using the Chisel Tool to change the designs of some Blocks. 

You can Right Click with the Chisel to open its GUI, there you can put up to a stack of Blocks into it, then choose a design you want, and take it out. Or you can keep it in the Chisel, I don't see why you would want to though. 

You can also Left Click a Block with the Chisel to change its design without opening the Chisel GUI! 

Don't worry this one doesn't have Durability.

quests.title: Reactor Glass
quests.desc:
While protecting our Nuclear Reactors are important and viewing the contents of them relate to the safety of it. 

The Glass can also be used to make our bases look better! 

And really what's more important: safety and protection of our nuclear reactors? Or making our bases look better!

quests.title: Stone Blocks
quests.desc: You'll get this eventually, it's quite literally the most abundant Block in &2&lMinecraft&r.

quests.title: Handcrafted
quests.desc:
&l&3Handcrafted&r is for everything Decoration wise. 

There's Beds (that look good enough to sleep in, and I'm a picky sleeper!) and Nightstands for the Bedrooms. 

There's Chairs and Tables for Living Room. 

There's an Oven, Plates, and Bowls for the Kitchen. 

Heck there's even Statues just for showing off!

quests.title: Cooking for Blockheads
quests.desc: &l&cCooking for Blockheads&r is all about making the Kitchen your home. \n\nI recommend using everything it gives as every Item has a use and looks amazing!

quests.title: Sushi Go Crafting
quests.desc: &l&aSushi Go Crafting&r doesn't add many Blocks but the ones it does I highly recommend using in your Kitchen! \n\nEspecially the Rice Cooker; no more using the Microwave for Rice anymore.

quests.title: Farmer's Delight
quests.desc:
&l&eFarmer's Delight&r is all about Farming and Cooking Food Items! We can also use those same Items for Decoration and usage! 

The Stove, Pots, and Pans are perfect for a Kitchen. 

The Food Barrels are great for a Pantry. 

The Farm stuff is great for outdoor decor and the Cabinets are perfect for anywhere!

quests.title: Railcraft Glass
quests.desc: New types of Glass that can be used with your Trains! Or bases, \n\nI can't make you use it for anything specific.

quests.title: Framed Blocks
quests.desc:
&l&6Framed Blocks&r is the single most important Building Mod. Infact if you give me a Modpack and &l&6Framed Blocks&r is not in it, I won't play. It is that important! 

&l&6Framed Blocks&r gives us mock Blocks that can be filled in with any Block that isn't a Block Entity (Block Entities are Blocks like Crafting Table, Furnace, or Enrichment Chamber). 

These Frames can be just about any shape or anything! From vertical Slabs, to slopes, even quarter blocks! 

You want &5Netherite&r Stairs? Then use Framed Blocks! You want a Haybale Crafting Table? You can get it! You want perfect angles in your build? Then start making &l&6Framed Blocks&r!

quests.title: Vanilla Logs
quests.desc: The Logs from &2Vanilla &lMinecraft&r, found in the different &2Vanilla&r Biomes! \n\nI shouldn't have to explain anymore than that!

quests.title: Vanilla Stones
quests.desc: Remember when it was just Stone and Cobblestone?

quests.title: Oh The Biomes We've Gone Stones
quests.desc: In the new Biomes added by &l&aOh The Biomes We've Gone&r you can find 4 new Stone types: Dacite, Red Rock, Mossy Stone, and Rocky Stone. \n\nNow I'd like to know what separates the Rocky Stone from any other Stone that earns it the title of Rocky.

tasks.name: Oh The Biomes We've Gone Stones

quests.title: Eternal Starlight Stones
quests.desc:
&l&5Eternal Starlight&r is a whole new dimension to explore! 

And to those strictly looking for Building in &2&lMinecraft&r, you can find a bunch of new Stones in it! 

To get to the Dimension you'll need to find its Portal!

quests.title: Regions Unexplored Stones
quests.desc:
You can find these new Stone in the &l&cRegions Unexplored&r Biomes! 

No, the Mossy Stone is not the same as from &l&aOh The Biomes We've Gone&r. 

No, it's not the same as Mossy Stone Bricks.

quests.title: Chipped Stones
quests.desc: Only some of theses stones are chipped though.

quests.title: Storage Delight
quests.desc:
&l&6Storage Delight&r is all about Item Storage but making it look pretty. 

There's dozens of Drawers with different designs and Colors. 

It has the same use and space as a Barrel.

quests.title: Metal and Gem Blocks
quests.desc: While being the most expensive, they also are the prettiest! \n\nAnd that is what matters for Builds!

quests.title: AllTheOres Blocks
quests.desc:
&6&lAllTheOres&r is a built in-house mod made to help unify ores.

With that comes a ton of very useful decorative blocks!

&dFluorite&r and &9Sapphire&r both look very cool!

quests.title: Railcraft Stones
quests.desc:
&l&7Railcraft&r, along with Trains, adds some Stones for Decoration! 

Quarried and Abyssal Stone can be crafted together to make Polished, Chiseled, or Brick versions! 

Also don't forget Stairs and Slabs!

quests.title: Colored Blocks
quests.desc:
Color is one of the most important parts of making a Build more lively! 

It gives it life, personality, and color! 

Start with the Dyes!

quests.title: Painted Planks
quests.desc: &l&cRegions Unexplored&r also adds the ability for you to paint Planks as if they were Wool or Glass!

quests.title: Railcraft Colored Blocks
quests.desc: More Blocks added by &l&7Railcraft&r? I'm starting to doubt if it's even about Trains!

quests.title: Wall Lamps
quests.desc: Works similar to the &lSimply Lights&r, Inverted will Light when no Redstone is applied to it while normal will only work with Redstone. \n\nThese need to be attached to a Wall to be placed though.

quests.title: Plastic Construction Bricks
quests.desc:
Plastic Construction Bricks are Blocks made through &l&7PneumaticCraft: Repressurized&r. 

Just like their real life counter parts they hurt to step on! 

So either wear Shoes or smooth down the Bricks.

quests.title: Chipped Wool
quests.desc: Don't worry, these won't set on fire!

quests.title: Chipped Concrete
quests.desc: I've always hated how boring Concrete is, especially in real life. \n\nWell atleast in &2&lMinecraft&r with the &l&bChipped&r Mod we can get different designs with it!

quests.title: Chipped Terracotta
quests.desc: Even Glazed versions!

quests.title: Chipped Gem Blocks
quests.desc: &cRedstone&r, &9Lapis&r, Quartz, &5Amethyst&r, &aEmerald&r, and &bDiamonds&r are all precious Gems. \n\nSo of course we are turning them into Blocks, very pretty precious Blocks to be exact!

quests.title: Chipped Metals
quests.desc:
Don't even complain about this one. 

There are dozens of ways of getting Iron and it's needed for even just normal progression. 

You will get Iron, you will make it into a Block, and you will make it pretty!

quests.title: Now you're just showing off
quests.desc: Is this necessary?

quests.title: Chipped Copper
quests.desc:
&6Copper&r is the most abundant Ore in &2&lMinecraft&r and its main use is for decoration. 

There's already plenty of different variants added by &2&lMinecraft&r but &l&bChipped&r didn't think it was good enough! So we got more! 

Even variants for the oxidized versions. 

You can make faux &aEmerald Blocks&r.

quests.title: Mystical Agriculture Blocks
quests.desc: While they can be expensive they're also plenty stylish!

quests.title: Decor Mods!
quests.desc: These are Mods that I've found perfect for decorating your house or base! \n\nFeel free to check out even more than what's shown here!

quests.title: XyCraft World
quests.desc: &l&9X&cy&aC&8r&aa&cf&9t&r is all about the 5 different Colors, this includes using them for Blocks! \n\n&aGreen&r, &cRed&r, &9Blue&r, &8Dark&r, and Light Blocks of all sorts!

quests.title: Macaw's Mods
quests.desc:
&bMacaw Sketch&r is a very popular Mod Developer. He is known for Decor Mods. 
From Windows, to Pathways, to Drawers. He makes just about everything. 

Can you craft it all?

quests.title: Building Tips!
Tools!
quests.desc:
To build you will need Tools. And you will want Tools. 

Tools that can help you get Blocks, Tools to help you get different versions of those Blocks, and Tools to help you place Blocks! 

You'll need to start with a Stick!

quests.title: Decoration!
quests.desc:
The original &2&lMinecraft&r Chair, the stairs. 

Welcome to Modded &2&lMinecraft&r, we have much more than just stairs for decoration. 

There are dozens of mods that add decoration and even more that add items that can be used for decoration!

quests.title: Рийні кігті
quests.desc:
This isn't necessary but I find it very helpful. 

The Digging Claws increases your Pickaxe Tier, for your Hands. So you can Mine up to Iron Ore with just your Fists! 

That also includes mining things like Stone, Terracotta, and Concrete. And you can even mine those with the Blocks in your Hands. 

Honestly it basically is needed.

quests.title: Completed Macaw
quests.desc: You got one of everything from &b&lMacaw's Mods&r. I think you've earned it. \n\nAnd by it I mean you're own &bMacaw&r!

quests.title: AllRightsReserved
quests.desc:
Цей квест був створений &6командою AllTheMods&r або &2учасником спільноти&r для використання у збірках AllTheMods.

Оскільки всі збірки &6AllTheMods&r ліцензовані як &eВсі права захищено&r, цей квест не дозволяється використовувати у жодних публічних збірках, які не випущені командою &6AllTheMods Team&r без явного дозволу.

Цей квест навмисно прихований, якщо ви його бачите — ви перебуваєте в режимі редагування.

quests.title: Domun Ornamentum
quests.desc:
&l&5Domun Ornamentum&r is sort of like &l&6Framed Blocks&r and &l&bChipped&r put together! 

Using the Architects Cutter we can make tons of different Shapes and Variations of Blocks. 

When making a Block first choose which Group: Doors, Lights, ETC. 
Then, choose a Variant. 
After that, we need to add our Blocks we want it made of! Some Blocks will need two different Blocks of choice while others only take one.

quests.title: Changing Blocks
quests.desc: Minecraft already adds hundreds of Blocks, and Mods add hundreds more! But sometimes it is still not enough. \n\nWith some Mods we can change the Blocks we already have into ones with different shapes, designs, and even into entirely new Blocks!

quests.title: Cheating
quests.desc:
Supply Camps/Ships are Items added by &lMinecolonies&r. They are made to instantly make you a Base to live and start a Colony! 

You can Right Click them to open a Menu, there you'll have to choose the type of Camp/Ship you want! 

Then, you'll need to find a place to place it. The land must be flat, Red outlined Blocks tell you what needs to go! 

Once it is set, your new Camp/Ship will be built entirely for free! 

It'll have Townhalls, Beds, Supplies, and plenty more!

quests.title: Quarries and Mines
quests.desc:
Terraforming is an important part to even the simplest of Builds. But we &2&lMinecraft&r Players just simply don't have the time or effort to do so. 

So why not let Machines do it for us? 

Quarries are very easy ways of doing so but they all start with Block Breakers. The Simple Block Breaker will only break what is in front of it, not the most helpful... 

But the Advanced Block Breaker will Mine a set Area! Much better for Terraforming!

quests.title: Mr Crayfish's Mods
quests.desc:
&cMr Crayfish&r is a name synonymous with Modded &2&lMinecraft&r. 

His most downloaded Mod is the Furniture Mod of course! 

To get started you'll need a Workbench, which needs Energy to work.

quests.title: Bathroom Set
quests.desc:
Sinks, Toilets, and Baths! 

Everything you need to keep fresh and hygenic! 

All of them hold Water and yes you can sit on the Toilets.

quests.title: Bedroom Set
quests.desc: Plenty of Lights and Storage for your place of rest.

quests.title: Kitchen Set
quests.desc: The Kitchen holds many Blocks that can hold, preserve, and Cook Food! \n\nMost the Blocks that cook or prepare Food do need Energy, so check out the Electrical Set to learn more!

quests.title: Outdoor Set
quests.desc: We've seen enough Furniture for the inside, but what about the outside? Can't have a 4th of July BBQ inside! \n\nThe outdoor set gives us Grills, Coolers, and Doorbells for Guests to ring to let us know they have arrived with patriotic hearts!

quests.title: Electric Set
quests.desc:
Tons of the Items in &cMr Crayfish's&r Mod use Energy! 

To power them you'll need an Electricity Generator. These take Coal or other Furnace Fuels to power up! 

Then, you'll need a Wrench to connect the Generator to your Blocks that need Energy. 

When the Generator is turned on with the Switch at the top and it has Fuel, it will power anything connected.

quests.title: Dyenamics
quests.desc:
The 16 Colors &2&lMinecraft&r gives you isn't enough? 

Well I guess you could have 18 more! 

&l&cDy&6en&ea&ami&bcs&r gives us 18 more Dyes all which can be used for the exact same Items and Blocks &2&lMinecraft's&r Dyes do! 

You want a &6Peach&r Candle? You can get one! You want a &dBumblegum&r Shulker? Why not! You want a &eFluorscent&r Bed? Of course!

quests.title: Undergarden Metals
quests.desc:
&bFroststeel&r, &7Cloggrum&r, and &eRegalium&r can be Mined for. 
&cUtheric&r and &aForgotten&r you need to kill for. 

Any other questions?

quests.title: Compact Machines
quests.desc:
&lCompact Machines&r allow you to enter a compacted dimension. After placing a &lCompact Machine&r, you can enter it using the Personal Shrinking Device.

The size of the &lCompact Machine&r is dependent on the recipe, ranging from 5x5x5 to 45x45x45!

You can't break the &lCompact Machine&r's walls, and you can exit by Right Clicking the Personal Shrinking Device.

quests.title: Builds from our friends
quests.desc:
All the beautiful Builds you see on this Quest Page are from people in the ATM Discord! 

Don't worry all have given consent to sharing their Builds and have been credited! 

If you wish to share your Builds as well, check out the artwork-builds-showoff Channel in the Discord! 

(I can not assure that all Builds were made in ATM10 only that they were made by fellow Minecraft Players. Same ways that some might use Shaders, so if your Builds aren't exactly the same that could be why!)

quests.title: Eternal Starlight Metals
quests.desc: Oh did you think &5&lEternal Starlight&r will have you get all these Metals the easy way? \n\nHA! don't be stupid. You'll have to fight Bosses, dig through Mud, and look for Meteor Showers!

quests.title: Eternal Starlight Trees
quests.desc:
The &5&lEternal Starlight&r is home to plenty of unique Items, Mobs, and Blocks. 

Trees aswell! 

You can find these Trees all over the Dimension in almost every Biome.

quests.title: Luminax
quests.desc:
&c&lLuminax&r is a very simple Mod. You like Colored Lights? You can have Colored Lights. 

They are all one color with no Texturing and can come in different Shapes like Stairs or Slabs or even Pressure Plates! 

They even work with &l&cDy&6en&ea&ami&bcs&r!

quests.title: Construction Sticks
quests.desc:
Ever miss &lConstruction Wands&r? 

Well I did, and so did &9Mrbysco&r! So he made &l&6Construction Sticks&r! 

There's a few different Tier of &6Construction Stick&r. The more expensive they are, the more Durability they have and the more Blocks they can place. 

They will start by just placing Blocks to fill a space, but their options can be changed by opening their GUI. You'll need to set a Keybind yourself to do it. 

Once you open it, you can change everything about them. Where they place Blocks, in what pattern, and even what Blocks to place down! 

They also have their own Upgrades you can Craft. To use them, combine the Upgrade with your &6Construction Stick&r in a Smithing Table.

quests.title: Crystalix
quests.desc:
What does &9&lCrystalix&r give us you ask? 
It gives Glass! All different types of Glass! There is Normal, Clear, and Bordered. 

Bordered is the normal &2&lMinecraft&r Glass pattern. It has borders and pixels near corner to let you know it is Glass. Clear has the borders but no pixels near the corners, so the inside is all clear. Normal has no borders or pixels, it is entirely 100% clear and one color. 

Each &9&lCrystalix&r Glass has its own properties as well: Shadeless, Reinforced, Light, and Ghost. 

Shadeless will affect how it reacts to Shaders and even &2&lMinecraft&r lighting. Reinforced will affect Blast Resistance. Light will affect whether it gives Light, ignores Light, or acts like normal Glass, letting Light in. Ghost will be able to change who can walk through the Glass, this one has the most settings.

quests.title: Camol
